rules.text: the نون of رفع (on the five verbs, e.g. تفعلون) and the نون of نسوة (feminine plural, e.g. يفعلن) are DISTINCT nūns; this pack classifies IDENTITY only, never a mood, case or governor
نون الرفع always follows a long vowel/glide (و، ا، ي); نون النسوة always attaches directly to a consonant stem final -- both POS and the preceding-letter evidence are required together
occurrence-level dropping of نون الرفع under a governor (نصب/جزم) is a Naḥw fact this pack never emits; it classifies the nūn's identity on a surface that carries it
